description: Forge-hardened npm publishing for JS/TS libraries. Multi-runner reproducible-build attestation, OIDC trusted publishing, hard pre-publish gates. Pure bash, zero dependencies.
rules: anvil is a GitHub Action. Reusable workflow: uses: forgesworn/anvil/.github/workflows/release.yml@v0 (full four-job DAG with reproducible-build gate). Composite action: uses: forgesworn/anvil@v0 (no reproduce gate, needs actions/checkout before it).
Node must ship npm >= 11.5.x for OIDC. Trusted publishing configured on npmjs.com must point at the consumer's repo and caller workflow, not forgesworn/anvil.

Exports-map check (verify-exports.sh): jq walks full package.json exports tree (all conditional keys + nested) plus legacy main/module/types/typings/bin. Every ./ leaf path must exist on disk. Runs automatically, no config needed.
Runtime npm audit (verify-audit.sh): runs npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=$AUDIT_LEVEL. Only runtime deps checked; devDeps ignored. Configure threshold via audit-level input (default: low).

Action-pin audit (verify-action-pins.sh): scans .github/workflows/*.yml, flags uses: refs not pinned to 40-char SHA. strict-action-pins input (default: true) controls fail vs warn. forgesworn/anvil self-exempt.

Tarball stamping: record-tarball.sh records filename/size/sha256/sha512 to tarball.meta. update-release.sh stamps Artefact Integrity block into GitHub Release body with verify recipe, uploads .tgz as release asset.

SLSA provenance: use publishConfig.provenance: true in package.json (NOT --provenance CLI flag; npm 11.6+ breaks OIDC with explicit flag). Requires id-token: write. Verify via npm audit signatures or Provenance badge on npmjs.com.

Custom pre-publish checks: use vector-test-command input for additional validation (e.g. frozen test vectors). For full custom job structure, use the composite action with extra steps before/after it. All step scripts in steps/ can also be run individually.
